final: WITH rental_payments AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id) SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total_per_rental, AVG(payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM rental_payments GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
